attributes.action: No child maintenance to women who stop contact for no reason
attributes.background: Stop women getting child maintenance if dad has to fight in court with no reason behind it such as no safeguarding issues

rejection.details:
Petitions need to call on the Government or Parliament to take a specific action.

You want child maintenance payments to stop when a parent prevents the other parent from having contact with their child without a safeguarding reason.

We're not sure how you want this to work, including who would decide whether contact was being prevented without good reason, and whether payments would stop automatically or following a court decision.
